injury.shortComment: Kuminga (shoulder) exited in the fourth quarter of Monday's 106-98 win over Portland and did not return. He closed with 13 points (5-12 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), nine rebounds and one assist across 29 minutes.
injury.detail: Kuminga put together a productive performance before aggravating his right shoulder on a shot attempt, exiting at the 6:35 mark of the fourth quarter and not returning. The forward's next chance to suit up will come Tuesday in a rematch against Portland, though the quick turnaround makes his availability highly questionable pending further updates. Should Kuminga miss time, Terrence Shannon could see an increased workload.
